summary: The discussion addressed timing mismatches between compute and network layers, leading to a proposal for a solution that integrates compute and network awareness. A presentation on cutting-edge Optical Transport Network (OTN) solutions highlighted how traditional packet-based steering fails to meet the stringent latency and determinism requirements of high-demand workloads like AI model training and inference. The proposed framework extends existing concepts to OTN, utilizing optical transport containers to provide end-to-end hard isolation and deterministic transport by dynamically selecting paths based on both optical link performance and real-time compute resource states.
